measurement_bins: 25/50/75 percentiles of finite values in each original annual training fold; duplicate cuts removed; missing/nonfinite evaluation values kept as unavailable. No evaluation-based cut selection.
regions: Rank by extra false-positive windows versus named control; compare top-ten extra-FP share with negative-window exposure. Also retain net and removed errors.
runs: Exact one-hour adjacency within one HARP; all gaps and nonmatching windows break runs. Describe extra-FP and all candidate-FP runs, including >=6-window runs.
scope: Adaptive descriptive development audit, not independent model selection, causal attribution or significance testing. Thresholds remain frozen; recall may differ between arms.
prohibitions: No training or threshold changes during the ongoing experiment
No inference that future zero-positive regions are an available predictor
